evidence_requests: Provide the underlying contents of BMCARD-034-A through BMCARD-034-E, especially the aggregate eval results, slice-level results, and threshold definitions.
Provide the source record establishing whether the small-business support slice is material under the governing policy.
Provide the mitigation approval log or control record showing whether any mitigation has been approved and whether it removes deployment exposure.
Provide the exact proposed certification/model-card disclosure text to verify that the weakness and lack of approved mitigation are expressly disclosed.

decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if admissible evidence shows the material weakness is expressly disclosed or an approved mitigation removes deployment exposure.
Aggregate pass rates may support general launch readiness but cannot erase subgroup weakness.
Small-sample uncertainty may justify follow-up confirmation, but it cannot convert an unresolved materiality issue into a clean certification.
Unsupported policy predicates or unsupported factual predicates should prevent a fully compliant finding even if the actor's conclusion is directionally plausible.
